svg.title: EVPN type-2/3 routes over a VXLAN leaf-spine
svg.text: 29 · EVPN type-2/3 routes over a VXLAN leaf-spine

g.text: eBGP underlay: leaf1 advertises its VTEP loopback 10.255.0.1/32 to both spines (AS 65101 → 65000).
Spines re-advertise leaf2's 10.255.0.2/32; leaf1 installs two equal-cost paths to leaf2's VTEP.
Leaf-to-leaf multihop eBGP carries EVPN: type-3 (IMET) joins VNI 100's BUM tree; type-2 maps h2's MAC.
h1 pings h2 (10.10.10.22): leaf1 VXLAN-encapsulates with VNI 100 to 10.255.0.2 via spine1.
leaf2 decapsulates to h2; the reply re-encapsulates and returns via spine2 — both uplinks carry traffic.
